- testOrAdd: add evaluator after construction, check matches.

- testOrMatches: ensure OR logic.

- testOrToString: ensure comma separated.

Thus test file starts with package org.jsoup.select; imports.

We'll create inner class StubEvaluator extends Evaluator, implements matches based on a boolean flag.

    private final String name;
    StubEvaluator(boolean result, String name) { this.result = result; this.name = name; }
    @Override public boolean matches(Element root, Element node) { return result; }
